section.content: 本发明的实施例涉及种半导体集成电路。该半导体集成电路包括衬底、第晶体管和第图案化的导电层。第晶体管具有在衬底中的源极区域、漏极区域以及在衬底上的栅极区域。第图案化的导电层电连接至第晶体管的漏极区域。第图案化的导电层包括第区段、第二区段和可熔器件。

Embodiments of the invention are related to a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit.The semiconductor integrated circuit includes the conductive layer of substrate, the first transistor and the first patterning.The first transistor is with source region in the substrate, drain region and the area of grid on substrate.The conductive layer of the first patterning is electrically connected to the drain region of the first transistor.The conductive layer of the first patterning includes the first section, the second section and fusible device.

Semiconductor integrated circuitTechnical field

Embodiments of the invention relate in general to semiconductor applications, more particularly, to semiconductor integrated circuit.

Background technology

In the developing stage of integrated circuit, answering for circuit (such as CPU (CPU) or microprocessor) is controlled It is written into read-only storage (ROM) with program.Then, in the fabrication stage, manufacture control circuit is while the program storage is in ROM In.ROM can be manufactured by masking, so that the data of record are limited by specific photoetching mask structure.Additionally, each is stored Unit is constituted by transistor.The binary data remembered in this element is by for exhausting or the enhanced implant operation phase Between transistor it is masked or not masked the fact limit.Then, integrated circuit is tested.If the application of integrated circuit is Considerably complicated one kind, then be easy to mistake occur in a program.In order to correct the mistake, it is probably have that integrated circuit is manufactured again Necessary, this includes the new procedures of control circuit and corrigendum.This means the mask using new a group, therefore cause relatively high Cost and tediously long operation.

In order to provide the flexibility of IC design, random access memory (RAM) is used for answering for storage control circuit Use program.The mistake of application program can be corrected in RAM, and then can be sent to ROM integrated to complete for corrected program Circuit.Compared to ROM constructions are changed, can time-consuming and cost using additional RAM.However, additional RAM is inevitably Certain space or area can be taken, the size of integrated circuit is which increased.Furthermore, it is necessary to additional peripheral circuit is controlling or prop up Additional RAM is held, this complicates circuit design and power management.

RRAM is a kind of favored form of nonvolatile memory, and it has low-work voltage, high speed characteristics and good Durability.Change of the memory cell of RRAM by determining the resistance of film (usually metal oxide film) is worked.Additionally, electric Resistance corresponds to the information (for example, value of " 0 " or " 1 ") of storage.RRAM generally includes the array of this memory cell.RRAM device Memory cell include the data storage elements with two electrodes and the variable resistive material layer between two electrodes. The variable resistive material layer (also referred to as data storage layer, memory film or resistance-type film) is according to applying between the electrodes The polarity and/or amplitude of electric signal (for example, voltage or electric current) have the reversible change of resistance.The variable resistive material layer is usual Formed by transition metal oxide.

MRAM device includes the array of mram cell, and each in mram cell is implemented as unit cell to store two Binary data value.Each mram cell includes the magnetic tunnel-junction formed by a pair of ferroelectric layers, and this pair of ferroelectric layer is by thin dielectric layer Separate.One ferroelectric layer (also referred to as reference layer) is characterised by magnetizing with fixed-direction, and another ferroelectric layer is (also referred to as Accumulation layer) it is characterised by that the direction changed with the write-in (for example, by applying magnetic field) based on device magnetizes.Work as reference layer During with the respective magnetization antiparallel of accumulation layer, the resistance of magnetic tunnel-junction is high, i.e. high logic state " 1 ".On the other hand, when each From magnetization parallel when, the resistance of magnetic tunnel-junction is low, i.e. low logic state " 0 ".By by the resistance value of mram cell with reference Resistance value is compared to read the logic state of mram cell, wherein, reference resistance value represents the electricity in high logic state " 1 " Intermediate resistance value between the resistance value of resistance and low logic state " 0 ".

Ferroelectric memory (FeRAM) is to be used as ferroelectric material (SBT or PZT) to be located between bottom electrode and top electrodes Capacitor dielectric nonvolatile memory.FeRAM is implemented to read and write operation.Memory-size and memory knot The reading of structure influence FeRAM and write-access number of times.The non-volatile of FeRAM is because the bistable state of ferroelectric storage unit is special Property.Using two kinds of memory cell, single capacitor memory cell and dual capacitor memory cell.Single capacitor memory cell (being referred to as 1T/1C or 1C memory cell) needs less silicon area (thus increasing the potential density of memory array), but It is to be easier to be influenceed by noise and technique change.Additionally, 1C units need Voltage Reference to determine the memory state of storage.It is double Capacitor memory units (being referred to as 2T/2C or 2C memory cell) bigger silicon area of needs, and its storage allow to storage Information carry out the complementary signal of difference sampling.2C memory cell is more stable than 1C memory cell.

For applicability purpose, resistance variable memory can be described as programmable Conductive Random Access memory (PCRAM) Or phase change random access memory devices (PCRAM), have been investigated as half volatibility and nonvolatile RAM part. In PCRAM devices, chalcogenide glass framework (chalcogenide glass backbone) can be programmed for stabilization Compared with low electric conductivity (that is, high electrical resistance) and high electrical conductivity (that is, compared with low resistance) state.Unprogrammed PCRAM devices are generally located In more low electric conductivity or more high resistance state.

Regulation operation forms the conductive channel of the metal chalcogenide in PCRAM devices, and conductive channel support changes device Electric conductivity/resistance states conductive path.Even if after device is wiped free of, conductive channel is also maintained in glass backbone. After operation is adjusted, PCRAM is programmed to more high connductivity state by write operation, and wherein metal ion is accumulated along conductive channel. The PCRAM devices can be read by applying the voltage smaller than voltage needed for programming PCRAM devices.Across the electric current of memory device Or resistance be sensed to be it is higher or lower to limit logical one and " 0 " state.Can be reverse relative to write-in voltage by applying Voltage (phase reverse bias) wipes PCRAM, backward voltage destruction conductive path, but it is complete to be to maintain conductive channel.By this Mode, this device can act as the resistance variable memory with least two conductivity states, at least two electric conductivity State can limit two corresponding logic states, i.e. at least a data.
